headline: Binance Took In 209.0 Million Dollars, Down From 416.2 Million
narrative: Binance took in 209.0 million dollars over 24 hours, down from 416.2 million, while exchanges overall took in 294.0 million dollars, 0.1091 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, down from 413.1 million dollars and 0.1539 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means money arrived where holders can sell, and the smaller print means that arrival slowed. Bybit took in 43.3 million dollars, while Bitfinex shed 63.0 million and Bitget shed 39.7 million.
author: jordan
